description: A sun-drenched outdoor terrace with sweeping countryside views. A three-seat teak outdoor sofa with thick stone-gray all-weather cushions sits on a hardwood deck of warm medium-toned planks, oriented to face an open panorama of rolling green hills under a bright blue sky. Two throw pillows in a fine gray and white stripe accent the neutral cushions. A companion lounge chair or ottoman in matching teak and stone fabric is partially visible at the left edge of frame. Beneath the seating, a large natural jute flatweave rug grounds the outdoor living zone. To the left of the sofa, a mature tree with rounded canopy provides dappled overhead shade over a portion of the deck. A sculptural cream or sandy-beige ribbed column form — a tall cylindrical object with horizontal layered fins and a metallic chrome base disc — stands beside the sofa. The backdrop is an unobstructed Mediterranean or Tuscan-style hillside landscape of layered green textures, with olive or native shrub plantings in the middle ground. The light is open, bright, midday natural sunlight. Palette is warm neutral — teak wood, oat cushions, jute — against vivid outdoor green and blue. Camera is at seated to standing eye-level, in a three-quarter view, normal focal length, capturing the full sofa and its setting with the landscape visible as backdrop. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
